title: Barbarian_Arms_5_Week_Mesocycle
author: Cody H.
desc: Unleash your inner strength with the Barbarian Arms 5-Week Mesocycle, designed to sculpt and define your upper body. This focused program spans 5 weeks, featuring 4 intense training sessions each week that target all major muscle groups in your arms. With a blend of compound lifts and isolation exercises, you'll build muscle endurance and power, ensuring you see tangible results. Get ready to push your limits and transform your physique!
